paper_metadata.title: Tongyi DeepResearch Technical Report
paper_metadata.abstract: We present Tongyi DeepResearch, an agentic large language model, which is specifically designed for long-horizon, deep information-seeking research tasks. To incentivize autonomous deep research agency, Tongyi DeepResearch is developed through an end-to-end training framework that combines agentic mid-training and agentic post-training, enabling scalable reasoning and information seeking across complex tasks. We design a highly scalable data synthesis pipeline that is fully automatic, without relying on costly human annotation, and empowers all training stages. By constructing customized environments for each stage, our system enables stable and consistent interactions throughout. Tongyi DeepResearch, featuring 30.5 billion total parameters, with only 3.3 billion activated per token, achieves state-of-the-art performance across a range of agentic deep research benchmarks, including Humanity's Last Exam, BrowseComp, BrowseComp-ZH, WebWalkerQA, xbench-DeepSearch, FRAMES and xbench-DeepSearch-2510. We open-source the model, framework, and complete solutions to empower the community.

extraction_data.innovation: Synthetic agentic data generation (Dataflywheel): synthesizes research-level questions and agentic behavior data to iteratively evolve the agent model, overcoming the economic prohibitive cost and non-stationarity of relying solely on real-world environments; Adaptive environment interaction design: models environments into Prior World (stable, zero cost, unlimited), Simulated (stable, low cost, reproducible), and Real-world (high fidelity) forms to balance stability, fidelity, and cost during training; Dynamic context management via Markovian state reconstruction: conditions the agent on a reconstructed workspace (question, evolving report/compressed memory, immediate context) rather than complete history, mitigating context overflow and maintaining reasoning capacity across arbitrary exploration depths.
